cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Converts plain-English process descriptions into validated IEC 61131-3 Structured Text for low-cost ESP32-based PLCs, targeting SME manufacturers in emerging markets who lack access to certified PLC programmers.

test_prompts.prompt: When the conveyor sensor detects a bottle, activate the filler valve for 3 seconds, then close it and wait for the next bottle.
Advance the packaging line when a product is detected at the entry sensor. Stop the line if any of the three safety guards are triggered.
